description: DISRUPTIVE: stop and start a running server. soft (default) needs a timeout: after it, timeout_action=destroy hard-stops and restarts, ignore (API default) aborts and leaves the server running. hard power-cycles immediately. UpCloud: POST /1.3/server/{uuid}/restart.

stop_type.description: soft = ACPI shutdown signal (default); hard = equivalent of pulling the power cable.

timeout.description: Soft-stop timeout in seconds, 1-600. Required for a soft restart.

timeout_action.description: What to do if the soft stop times out: destroy (hard stop, then start) or ignore (give up).

name: upcloud_restart_server
title: Restart a server
